hook.line: This backtest shows almost an 80% win rate for the past 5 years.
hook.visual: Top half: young man in glasses with a fuzzy mic, close up; bottom half: a rising green equity curve; bold title with '80% winrate' in green over the seam.

beats.what: Face over a rising equity curve with the 80% win-rate title; cursor hovers along the curve
Chart with 'ICT' crossed out by a drawn line as he says this is not ICT
Parameter optimization screen shown as he names the first test
Walk-forward optimizer table with every row marked Pass
Live data and payouts shown as extra proof
Candlestick chart: the range box the algorithm detects
Gold bar highlights the entry when price breaks the range
Strategy report: winning and losing streaks bar chart
Returns to the equity curve; 'Visit link in bio!' caption while he points

why_it_works: Result first: a specific number (80% win rate, 2,270 trades, 5 years) in a highlighted title before any method
Face on top and chart below keep both the speaker and the evidence in view the whole time
Pre-empts the sceptic ('no, this is not ICT', 'why you can trust this') and stacks proof: optimization, walk-forward, stress tests, payouts
Ends on the same equity curve it opened with, so the loop is near seamless (measured loop 0.93)
weaknesses: 87 s with a 40 s unbroken shot; the middle sags into jargon
Charts and tables are tiny and unreadable on a phone
Win-rate and payout claims for a trading product are high-risk and hard to verify
for_robert: Use face-on-top, proof-below split and open and close on the same result screen for a clean loop; Fred could cross out the wrong answer like the 'ICT' strike.
